entities.summary: Joshua Kushner is an American businessman and venture capitalist. He is the founder and managing partner of the venture capital firm Thrive Capital, co-founder and vice-chairman of Oscar Health, and the youngest son of the real estate developer Charles Kushner. He is the younger brother of Jared Kushner, son-in-law and former senior advisor to the president of the United States Donald Trump.
